brief.product: Pet carrier backpack for small pets
brief.features:
Clear bubble dome window
Breathable mesh and air-vent holes
Expandable side panel
Padded adjustable straps
Reinforced safety zippers
brief.pets: Bruno the dog, Mishti the cat, Bunty the rabbit, and their human Aria

data.title: Onomie Pet Carrier Backpack Ad
data.voice_style: A warm, friendly, conversational Indian voice, transitioning from a slightly concerned tone to joyful excitement.

scenes.name: hook-problem
scenes.vo_text: अरे, आरिया को बाहर जाना है, पर ब्रूनो, मिष्टी, बंटी को कौन देखेगा? इन्हें अकेला छोड़ना मुश्किल!
scenes.vo_roman: Are, Aria ko bahar jaana hai, par Bruno, Mishti, Bunty ko kaun dekhega? Inhe akela chhodna mushkil!
scenes.headline: Leaving Pets Behind?

scenes.name: product-reveal
scenes.vo_text: अब नहीं! पेश है ओनॉमी का पेट कैरियर बैकपैक!
scenes.vo_roman: Ab nahin! Pesh hai Onomie ka pet carrier backpack!
scenes.headline: Problem Solved!

scenes.name: feature-dome-mesh-expand
scenes.vo_text: क्लियर बबल डोम, ब्रीदबल मेश, एक्सपेंडेबल साइड पैनल।
scenes.vo_roman: Clear bubble dome, breathable mesh, expandable side panel.
scenes.headline: Explore & Breathe!

scenes.name: feature-comfort-safety
scenes.vo_text: पैडेड स्ट्रैप्स से आरिया को भी आराम। रीइन्फोर्स्ड ज़िपर्स भी हैं।
scenes.vo_roman: Padded straps se Aria ko bhi aaram. Reinforced zippers bhi hain.
scenes.headline: Comfort & Safety!

scenes.name: happy-payoff
scenes.vo_text: अब हर जगह साथ, खुशियों का सफर।
scenes.vo_roman: Ab har jagah saath, khushiyon ka safar.
scenes.headline: Together Forever!

data.caption: Missing out on adventures with your furry friends? Not anymore! 🐾 Onomie's Pet Carrier Backpack makes every journey joyful for Bruno, Mishti, Bunty, and Aria! With a clear bubble dome, expandable space, and super comfy straps, every trip is an exciting experience. Get yours and start new adventures! ✨ Shop now, link in bio!
